name: FENAGRI National Federation of the Agro-Food Industry
address: Bd Mohamed Abdou Quartier Palmier 23, 20340 Casablanca
profile: The National Federation of the Agri-Food Industry (FENAGRI) was established in 1998 with the mission of bringing together professionals and companies from Morocco’s agri-food industry. It works to structure and unify the sector’s ecosystem and acts as a credible representative vis-à-vis institutional, financial, and public partners, both nationally and internationally. As the leading network of agri-food entrepreneurs in Morocco, FENAGRI brings together around fifteen professional federations and associations from the industrial downstream sector, as well as a broad network of agri-food companies operating across various value chains. Fenagri actively promotes the food processing sector at both national and international levels through a structured promotional action plan aimed at supporting Moroccan industrial operators. FENAGRI promotes sustainable socio-economic development of Morocco’s food industries, represents and defends the interests of local companies, and supports the development of agri-industrial exports and investment. It also actively encourages international partnerships and supports Moroccan companies in accessing global markets. Its activities are structured around six priority thematic committees: – Healthy and Safe Food – Human Resources Development – Upstream and Processing – Research, Development and Innovation – Foreign Trade – Environment, Sustainable Development and Climate Finance In its unifying role, FENAGRI is also leading the revival of the Technical Center for the Agri-Food Industry (CETIA) as a research, development and innovation hub, in close coordination with key sector stakeholders. On the occasion of ISM , FENAGRI has reserved a Moroccan Pavilion to showcase national expertise and support the participation of the following Moroccan companies: Magic Sweets International, Cahimsa, Best Biscuits Maroc, Ebbo Maroc, Ema Chocolate and Gaudium.
